content.title: Is there an AI bubble? BlackRock, BofA don't seem to think so
content.description:
Wall Street has gone back and forth over whether the market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) is in an AI bubble or not. BlackRock and Bank of America apparently have the answer: we're not in a bubble.

Market Domination host Josh Lipton is joined by Yahoo Finance senior reporter Allie Canal to examine new AI outlooks from the two top Wall Street firms, including their consensus on the K-shaped economy.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

Bitcoin rebounds, ETFs take hit, BofA recommends crypto: 3 Things
content.description:
US stock futures (ES=F, NQ=F, YM=F) are rising in Tuesday's pre-market trading as bitcoin (BTC-USD) bounces back above $87,000 per token.

As bitcoin's recent volatility has dragged crypto stocks lower, particularly hitting Strategy's (MSTR) ETFs in 2025.
